core_requests: core/ranges.py (P034 cond 1): promote RangeIndex (+ as_ip, as_network) from v3lum/modules/ip_network/cloud_ranges.py to v3lum/core/ranges.py as the one shared IP-range index (sorted integer intervals + bisect, IPv4/IPv6); nicbr_asn already reuses it, ip_context_lists/ip_offline_db/ip_blocklists/tor_relays should import it from core.

noise (P034 cond 1/6, AR06): a noise-provider hook, e.g. noise.register_provider(name, fn) with missing data not reported by noise.errors(), registering cloud_ranges.noise_kind_for (local copies only, no network). noise.register_list cannot read the provider JSON files and makes noise.errors() non-empty while a dataset is not downloaded, so the contract test fails.

engine + ui/render.py + report/html.py (P034 cond 7/9): expand=False and the pivot note 'not pivoted: shared CDN/cloud IP' for IP-reputation/co-hosting pivots onto IPs labelled cdn_edge/shared_hosting/shared_service/shared_proxy (never suppressing domain/URL findings), and the cloud_label shown next to IP entities in the terminal entity map and HTML.

scope guard / doctor / engine (P034 cond 8, A7, P378): the ACTIVE scope guard (WP11) calls cloud_ranges.active_guard() to refuse probes of CDN/shared-hosting IPs not listed in the scope and to fail closed when the range data is missing or older than 7 days; doctor (WP25) calls cloud_ranges.dataset_status() and warns; the engine tags own assets resolving to noise ranges third_party_hosted.
datasets (P034 cond 4): pass the response content type to register_dataset validators (or add content_types=); validators now check HTML/challenge bodies, size, parse success and entry counts.

tests/test_datasets.py: the _isolated_registry fixture should clear DATASETS before each test; test_first_run_hint_and_update_all fails in the full suite because 26 essential datasets from 10 modules are registered (8 from this batch: seven official cloud_ranges files + the NIC.br list) and passes alone.
vocab (P038 cond 4): add relation network_provider to v3lum.core.vocab.RELATIONS (the condition names core/vocab.py); it ships meanwhile in v3lum/data/vocab/p1-G02-1.json.
engine (P038 cond 3): a contract name for EXPAND_CAP; nicbr_asn reads v3lum.core.engine.EXPAND_CAP lazily with a fallback because engine.py is not in the module contract.
dns (P032 cond 4): cache DoH answers by the record TTL (min(answer/SOA TTL, DoH profile TTL)) instead of the resolver profile TTL of 3600 s.

http (P031 cond 4): a module-facing streaming read in ctx.http (chunk iterator with the P321 classification on the head); ScopedHttp drops stream_to, so announced-prefixes is capped at 4 MB and scanned incrementally.

acceptance harness (WP27/AR21): dataset pre-seeding (install local copies before the scan) so cloud_ranges (ipv4 8.8.8.8) and nicbr_asn (cnpj 00000000000191) can ship golden routes; trimmed bodies fail the download validation by design.

org seed (A11/P378, P038 cond 5): `v3lum org seed` consumes nicbr_asn's owned_networks (candidate_own_netblocks, scope_eligible false) and asks the analyst to confirm each entry; derived prefixes never join an ACTIVE scope automatically.

providers (P034 tier): a per-source tier (or a tier override in provider-ext/1) so community-maintained data hosted on GitHub (cloudcheck, tier community per the chair) is not shown with the github provider's trusted tier; no gating impact today because cloud_ranges has disclosure none.
notes: Four modules in four files, every final condition implemented or recorded with its unblock condition in docs/backlog/p1-G02-1.md (14 rows). Decisions to confirm: (1) P032 cond 2 - core vocab defines belongs_to_asn as IP -> ASN and in_network as IP -> CIDR, so team_cymru_asn (and ripestat/nicbr_asn) pivot the ASN with belongs_to_asn (expand only from the seed) and the prefix with in_network (expand=False); (2) P034 cond 4 read strictly - 'not cloud' (EMPTY) only when every allowed dataset is loaded, a lookup with no match and any missing dataset is UNAVAILABLE 'could not verify', a match still stands, and each missing feed is reported per source; (3) P034 cond 6 - Akamai (cloudcheck data includes Linode AS63949 compute) and Microsoft/Azure ranges are provider_network, not noise, until a source separates edges from compute (backlog); is_hosting is true for iaas and shared_hosting; iaas carries verdict_lifetime_days 14; (4) cloud_ranges provider_tier community is the council value (lowest dataset provider, cloudcheck), but registry tiers are per provider and the GitHub-hosted sources extend the core github provider (trusted shared-hosting platform per its tier_rationale), so the community tier is recorded in the source notes; the module has disclosure none (trust_tier n/a); (5) the seven official provider files and the NIC.br list are essential=True (first-run hint); GitHub meta and cloudcheck (AGPL, runtime-only with a notice) are not; (6) nicbr_asn extras: CPF-shaped owner ids are discarded together with the owner name, registrant CNPJs that look like MEI (individual entrepreneurs) pivot with expand=False (LGPD), and network providers come from a V3LUM-authored bundled list (v3lum/data/nicbr_asn/br_network_providers.json, 19 entries verified against the NIC.br file) plus owner-name keywords; (7) ripestat never caches the raw whois answer (cache_if) because person objects are dropped only at ingestion; rir-geo is shown as registration_country context, never as country; the shared abuse helper for P345 is ripestat.lookup_abuse_contacts(http, resource) / abuse_contact_records().
